connector.name: Bsc Dex Spread
connector.registryDescription: Cross-DEX price & spread for PancakeSwap v2+v3 on BSC via x402. Tool get_dex_spread(pair, fee?).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package bsc-dex-spread-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the donnywin85 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.

env.description: Your Base-mainnet buyer wallet private key (0x-prefixed). Funded with a few dollars of USDC on Base; needs zero ETH. Pays $0.01 USDC per call.

env.description: Optional override of the gateway base URL. Defaults to https://x402.donnyautomation.com
